title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Author record for Emmy Noether in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page keeps Noether material together by author: original-language modern LaTeX reader PDFs, current English translation drafts, and source/artifact files.

Status at a glance.

  • Original-language modern LaTeX reader: [######----] selected mathematical-papers draft is front-facing here; publisher collected-volume wrapper pages have been removed.
  • English translation: [########--] current reader includes the 1910 invariant-theory note, the 1916 finite-groups invariant theorem, the current two-part draft on integral rational representation of invariants, the absolute irreducibility criterion and continuation, formal variational calculus and differential invariants, polynomial ideals and resultants, algebraic and differential invariants, elimination theory, general ideal theory, short reports on abstract ideal theory, Hilbert numbers, group characters, the opening of abstract ideal theory in algebraic number and function fields, and the latest delivered clean continuation packet.
  • Source/artifact preservation: [##########] available TeX, component PDFs, rendered translation pieces, and provenance are in the artifact ZIP.
  • Proofreading/final edition status: [----------] working drafts for checking, not certified critical editions.

The organization is by author, not by language. Readers can download the original-language reader PDF and the English translation PDF separately from the file list, while complete sources and intermediate renders live in the artifact ZIP.
notes: Public author record: original-language and translation material are grouped together under Noether.
